certification.name: Microsoft Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate
certification.description: Nine-course entry-level program covering networking and cloud basics, threat vectors, identity and access in Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Defender, SIEM and compliance, plus SC-900 exam preparation. Course-based certificate assessed through capstone projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 6 months at 10 hours a week.
